tree.heading: Affiliate
tree.text: The term “affiliate”, with respect to a packer, means—

children.text: a person that directly or indirectly owns, controls, or holds with power to vote, 5 percent or more of the outstanding voting securities of the packer;
a person 5 percent or more of whose outstanding voting securities are directly or indirectly owned, controlled, or held with power to vote, by the packer; and
a person that directly or indirectly controls, or is controlled by or under common control with, the packer.

tree.heading: Applicable reporting period
tree.text: The term “applicable reporting period” means the period of time prescribed by the prior day report, the morning report, and the afternoon report, as required under section 1635j(c) of this title.

tree.heading: Barrow
tree.text: The term “barrow” means a neutered male swine.

tree.heading: Base market hog
tree.text: The term “base market hog” means a barrow or gilt for which no discounts are subtracted from and no premiums are added to the base price.

tree.heading: Boar
tree.text: The term “boar” means a sexually-intact male swine.

tree.heading: Formula price
tree.text: The term “formula price” means a price determined by a mathematical formula under which the price established for a specified market serves as the basis for the formula.

tree.heading: Gilt
tree.text: The term “gilt” means a young female swine that has not produced a litter.

tree.heading: Hog class
tree.text: The term “hog class” means, as applicable—

children.text: barrows or gilts;
sows; or
boars or stags.

tree.heading: Negotiated formula purchase
tree.text: The term “negotiated formula purchase” means a swine or pork market formula purchase under which—

children.text: the formula is determined by negotiation on a lot-by-lot basis; and
the swine are scheduled for delivery to the packer not later than 14 days after the date on which the formula is negotiated and swine are committed to the packer.

tree.heading: Noncarcass merit premium
tree.text: The term “noncarcass merit premium” means an increase in the base price of the swine offered by an individual packer or packing plant, based on any factor other than the characteristics of the carcass, if the actual amount of the premium is known before the sale and delivery of the swine.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “other market formula purchase” means a purchase of swine by a packer in which the pricing mechanism is a formula price based on any market other than the market for swine, pork, or a pork product.

children.heading: Inclusion
children.text: The term “other market formula purchase” includes a formula purchase in a case in which the price formula is based on one or more futures or options contracts.

tree.heading: Other purchase arrangement
tree.text: The term “other purchase arrangement” means a purchase of swine by a packer that—

children.text: is not a negotiated purchase, swine or pork market formula purchase, negotiated formula purchase, or other market formula purchase; and
does not involve packer-owned swine.

tree.heading: Packer
tree.text: The term “packer” means any person engaged in the business of buying swine in commerce for purposes of slaughter, of manufacturing or preparing meats or meat food products from swine for sale or shipment in commerce, or of marketing meats or meat food products from swine in an unmanufactured form acting as a wholesale broker, dealer, or distributor in commerce, except that—

children.text: the term includes only a swine processing plant that is federally inspected;
for any calendar year, the term includes only—
a swine processing plant that slaughtered an average of at least 100,000 swine per year during the immediately preceding five calendar years; and
a person that slaughtered an average of at least 200,000 sows, boars, or any combination thereof, per year during the immediately preceding five calendar years; and

in the case of a swine processing plant or person that did not slaughter swine during the immediately preceding 5 calendar years, the Secretary shall consider the plant capacity of the processing plant or person in determining whether the processing plant or person should be considered a packer under this part.

tree.heading: Packer-owned swine
tree.text: The term “packer-owned swine” means swine that a packer (including a subsidiary or affiliate of the packer) owns for at least 14 days immediately before slaughter.

tree.heading: Packer-sold swine
tree.text: The term “packer-sold swine” means the swine that are—

children.text: owned by a packer (including a subsidiary or affiliate of the packer) for more than 14 days immediately before sale for slaughter; and
sold for slaughter to another packer.

tree.heading: Pork
tree.text: The term “pork” means the meat of a porcine animal.

tree.heading: Pork product
tree.text: The term “pork product” means a product or byproduct produced or processed in whole or in part from pork.

tree.heading: Purchase data
tree.text: The term “purchase data” means all of the applicable data, including weight (if purchased live), for all swine purchased during the applicable reporting period, regardless of the expected delivery date of the swine, reported by—

children.text: hog class;
type of purchase; and
packer-owned swine.

tree.heading: Slaughter data
tree.text: The term “slaughter data” means all of the applicable data for all swine slaughtered by a packer during the applicable reporting period, regardless of when the price of the swine was negotiated or otherwise determined, reported by—

children.text: hog class;
type of purchase; and
packer-owned swine.

tree.heading: Sow
tree.text: The term “sow” means an adult female swine that has produced one or more litters.

tree.heading: Swine
tree.text: The term “swine” means a porcine animal raised to be a feeder pig, raised for seedstock, or raised for slaughter.

tree.heading: Swine or pork market formula purchase
tree.text: The term “swine or pork market formula purchase” means a purchase of swine by a packer in which the pricing mechanism is a formula price based on a market for swine, pork, or a pork product, other than a future or option for swine, pork, or a pork product.

tree.heading: Type of purchase
tree.text: The term “type of purchase”, with respect to swine, means—

children.text: a negotiated purchase;
other market formula purchase;
a swine or pork market formula purchase;
a negotiated formula purchase; and
other purchase arrangement.
